$comment: Teaching points the coverage map does not hold, because the worksheet types under them were made after it. Same fields as a coverage-map point (tp, grade, skill, code, strand). Kept few: a new type normally joins an existing point. A point marked `led` is taught by the teacher without a page (a routine with real objects, a number talk): it has no worksheet type by design.

points.skill: Plan and write a short story or message: a story map, a comic strip, a character description, a postcard
Solve one- and two-step addition and subtraction word problems within 100
Decode and encode a message with a key (picture code, number code, complete the key, make your own)
Say what can be measured about an object: how long, how heavy, how much it holds
Estimate lengths in inches, feet, centimeters and meters with body benchmarks, then measure
Explain why a way of adding or subtracting works, with place value and blocks or a drawing
